requirement: Implement and verify all Epic 3 stories: derive honest hardware recording passes from the v1.1 pattern, give the owner explicit guide controls, and present active/passed/unreached material consistently in the grid, pad, and scheduled audio.

architecture.decision: Replace active layer-teaching state with an ephemeral pass-based guide. src/guidance.ts owns the pure pattern-to-pass and pass-state contract; App owns guide lifecycle and projects its derived state into the existing grid, pad, transport, and audio callback.
alternatives: Persist guide order or completion alongside the pattern document.
Adapt the existing two-layer teaching model to approximate populated rows.
tradeoffs: A pure derived pass list cannot drift from pattern edits and keeps hardware completion explicitly user-confirmed.
Replacing the two-layer abstraction touches existing UI projections, but preserves the locked drum-row-first order and supports bass-only patterns honestly.
seams: src/guidance.ts exposes derivePasses, currentPass, passState, and redoPass as pure APIs.
src/App.tsx holds the non-persisted guide status and pass index, blocks/permits edits, and selects the presented instrument projection.
src/StepGrid.tsx, src/BeatPad.tsx, and src/audio.ts receive only derived pass-state/mix information.

tasks.title: Open Epic 3 Story 1 and create the pure guidance seam
tasks.intent: Synchronize trackers, then derive a deterministic hardware recording order entirely from the pattern.
constraints: Do not persist passes or progress.
An empty pattern produces no passes and cannot be started.
tasks.acceptance: Both trackers show Story 1 In progress; pure exports derive populated drums in visible pad order followed by bass, and distinguish not-started, active, and complete indices.
tasks.result: Added the pure deterministic pass selector: populated drum pads in native order followed by one optional bass pass, with explicit index-derived pass states.

tasks.title: Integrate the derived guide and close Story 1
tasks.intent: Expose an honest startable row-by-row guide from the deterministic pass list without storing guide metadata.
tasks.acceptance: The visible guide describes the current derived target and refuses to start an empty pattern; Story 1 tracker rows are Done only after build and browser inspection.
tasks.visual: Inspect populated-drum, bass-only, and empty guide states in the desktop workspace.
tasks.result: Integrated the derived pass list into the visible guidance panel, removed the reachable fixed two-layer lesson surface, and disabled start for empty patterns.
evidence: clean-reload browser: empty pattern shows disabled Start guidance
browser: populated Pad 1 shows enabled Start guidance and active now state

tasks.title: Implement explicit guide lifecycle controls and edit reset
tasks.intent: Let the user start, manually advance, pause/resume, restart, and redo a populated pass while keeping edit behavior honest.
constraints: Guided blocks edits; paused unlocks them and any accepted edit resets the guide.
Audio/pad REC are disabled during guidance.
tasks.acceptance: A user can remain on a target, advance manually, pause/resume with Play/Stop, restart after completion, and redo a passed pass; guide state is never serialized.
tasks.visual: Inspect Start/Next/Restart/Redo states and paused edit-reset feedback on desktop.
tasks.result: Added ephemeral guide lifecycle state, manual Next/Restart/Redo controls, pause/resume labels, guided edit/REC locks, and restart-on-edit for paused or complete guides.
evidence: browser: Start→Next→Restart and passed-row redo verified
browser: guided grid and REC controls disabled

tasks.title: Close Story 2 trackers and commit its verified result
tasks.intent: Record Story 2 verification only after the guide lifecycle and its edit/recording boundaries pass.
tasks.acceptance: Both Story 2 tracker rows are Done with build and interaction evidence before the Story 2 commit.
tasks.result: Closed Story 2 trackers after build, pure guidance, browser lifecycle, and accessibility-state checks; ready for the Story 3 mix hierarchy.

tasks.title: Project pass state into grid, pad, and scheduled audio
tasks.intent: Make active, passed, and unreached material visibly and audibly distinct from the one derived pass-state source.
constraints: Use existing Tone scheduling; no second transport or timers.
Unreached material is silent, passed material has reduced gain, and active material is foreground.
Colour is never the sole state cue.
tasks.acceptance: The active target has a grid accent and pad echo; passed rows play quieter; later rows are silent; REC is disabled while guided.
tasks.visual: Inspect a three-pass guide through first and second passes, including the pad projection and disabled REC control.
tasks.result: Projected the shared active/passed/unreached state into row labels/classes, LayerStack, active pad echoes, and Tone scheduling with -12 dB passed gain and silent unreached material.
evidence: browser: first pass passed and second pass active with row classes/labels
browser screenshot inspected at desktop viewport

tasks.title: Close Story 3 and Epic 3 with final verification
tasks.intent: Run complete Epic 3 checks, update durable and product trackers, and record the final implementation evidence.
constraints: Do not claim audible hardware verification without an output-device check.
Do not commit unrelated .gitignore, lockfile, or preview changes.
tasks.acceptance: All Epic 3 stories are Done, the production build passes, pure contracts pass, and desktop browser evidence records visual behavior with no console errors.
tasks.visual: Clean local browser guide walkthrough covering active/passed/unreached states.
tasks.result: Epic 3 closed after all three story commits, production build, pure guidance/gain checks, plan JSON validation, clean diff check, and desktop browser hierarchy inspection.
evidence: browser clean-reload hierarchy: passed and active labels/classes verified
audio-device check: no audible device was available in the browser session; no audible claim made
